mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return distribution in declining FEDFUNDS periods shows no significant positive mean relative to baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 240 signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL > 240 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline signal labor market strength that boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in PAYEMS/UNRATE trigger periods show no significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, rising HOUST indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in late-cycle expansion with rising HOUST are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising INDPRO trend reflects expanding manufacturing output that correlates with stronger corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in INDPRO rising periods show no significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE exceeding 5.0 signals economic weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in UNRATE > 5.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint FEDFUNDS > 0.35 and CPIAUCSL > 240 signals aggressive monetary tightening that causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in FEDFUNDS/CPIAUCSL trigger periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, RSAFS exceeding 460,000 signals consumer spending overextension that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in monetary tightening cycles with RSAFS > 460000 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.
